title: All Verdicts Executor
description: Run every command at once to its own verdict: none ends another, and each command a signal ended or that never ran is reported UNJUDGED by name.

commands.description: Shell commands, all started at once. An empty list is refused: it could never fail.

cwd.description: Where every command runs, relative to the workspace root.

eslintProjectRoot.description: The project, by workspace-relative root, whose ESLint sources replace {eslintSources} in a command when it runs.
